## What Is 3alamiy Web3?

3alamiy Web3 is a free crypto airdrop tracking and education platform. It provides manually verified, step-by-step participation guides for cryptocurrency airdrops. Users can filter airdrops by blockchain, difficulty, and cost. The platform also tracks upcoming tokenless projects with hype scores, publishes weekly picks, offers country-specific airdrop guides for 14 countries, and provides a Pro wallet eligibility scanner.

### Core Features

- Wallet Checker: paste any wallet address to see eligibility across 9 chains (Pro, $5/month)
- Weekly digest: top airdrops updated every Monday
- 65+ educational articles on airdrop strategy, DeFi, Web3, and country-specific guides
- 17 country guides: covers top crypto adoption countries with local exchange info and on-ramps

## What Is a Crypto Airdrop?

A crypto airdrop is a free distribution of cryptocurrency tokens by a blockchain project to early users, testers, or community members. Projects use airdrops to grow their user base, reward early adopters, and decentralize token ownership.

To qualify for an airdrop, users typically need to:
1. Use the project's protocol (swap, bridge, stake, or provide liquidity)
2. Complete social tasks (follow on Twitter, join Discord, complete Galxe quests)
3. Participate in testnets (test the protocol before mainnet launch)
4. Hold or stake certain tokens
5. Maintain consistent on-chain activity over time before a snapshot date

Legitimate airdrops never ask for your seed phrase. Sybil farming (using multiple wallets) is the #1 disqualifier in 2026.

---

## How to Get Crypto Airdrops in 2026

1. Set up a self-custody wallet: MetaMask for EVM chains, Phantom for Solana
2. Get small amounts of ETH or SOL for gas fees (many testnet airdrops are free)
3. Choose airdrops from a verified tracker (3alamiy Web3, CryptoRank, Airdrops.io)
4. Follow the step-by-step guide for each airdrop
5. Complete all required tasks (on-chain interactions, social tasks, testnets)
6. Maintain consistency — projects snapshot over months, not just once

Guide: https://www.3alamiyweb3.com/learn/how-to-get-crypto-airdrops-2026

## MetaMask Airdrop Guide 2026

**Entity:** MetaMask — Ethereum browser wallet built by ConsenSys. 30M+ monthly active users. Founded 2016. Supports EVM chains, DeFi, NFTs. $1B+ in annual swap fees. No token yet as of July 2026.

**Why an airdrop is likely:** MetaMask earns over $1B/year from swap fees. ConsenSys has discussed token governance. Every comparable wallet (Phantom, Rainbow) has either launched or is expected to launch a token. A token is structurally logical.

**Key July 2026 update:** MetaMask Franky SBT (Soulbound Token) is now live and free to mint. The Franky SBT is widely believed to be the snapshot mechanism for the MASK token distribution — it records on-chain eligibility. Minting it is free and takes under 2 minutes.

**How to farm:**
1. Mint the MetaMask Franky SBT — free, live now (top priority)
2. Swap tokens in MetaMask weekly (ETH ↔ USDC ↔ any token)
3. Use MetaMask Bridge across chains monthly
4. Stake ETH via MetaMask Portfolio staking tab
5. Connect Portfolio tab and track assets actively
6. Install and use Snaps (MetaMask plugins)
7. Apply for MetaMask Card (waitlist open)
8. Maintain 6+ months of consistent activity

**Guide:** https://www.3alamiyweb3.com/learn/metamask-airdrop-guide-2026
**MetaMask Rewards Season 2:** https://www.3alamiyweb3.com/learn/metamask-rewards-season-2-2026
**MetaMask Token Launch analysis:** https://www.3alamiyweb3.com/learn/metamask-token-launch-2026

## Phantom Airdrop Guide 2026

**Entity:** Phantom — multi-chain crypto wallet. 10M+ monthly active users. Raised $109M from Paradigm (Series B). Supports Solana, Ethereum, Polygon, Base. No token as of July 2026.

**Why an airdrop is likely:** $109M raised from Paradigm requires a token for investor returns. Phantom operates like a protocol — it generates revenue from swaps. Comparable wallets (MetaMask, Rainbow) are expected to launch tokens.

**How to farm:**
1. Swap SOL ↔ SPL tokens weekly using Phantom Swap
2. Stake SOL natively via Phantom (liquid staking tab)
3. Bridge to ETH/Polygon/Base and use Phantom on those chains
4. Mint/trade NFTs via Magic Eden through Phantom
5. Use DeFi protocols: Jupiter, Kamino, Raydium, Jito, Marinade
6. Use Phantom mobile app (mobile-first activity matters)
7. Maintain monthly activity for 6+ months

**Key fact:** Multi-chain usage (Solana + ETH + Polygon + Base) is a stronger signal than single-chain activity.

**Guide:** https://www.3alamiyweb3.com/learn/phantom-airdrop-guide-2026

## Soneium Airdrop Guide 2026

**Entity:** Soneium — Ethereum Layer 2 blockchain built by Sony Block Solutions Labs (joint venture: Sony Group Corporation + Startale Labs). OP Stack-based. Mainnet launched January 2025. No token as of July 2026. Sony has 100M+ PlayStation users, Sony Music catalog, extensive entertainment IP.

**Why an airdrop is likely:** Sony needs a token economy for entertainment use cases — music royalties, game item ownership, fan tokens, creator monetization. Every major OP Stack L2 has launched or is expected to launch a token (Optimism, Base, Mode). A token is structurally required.

**How to farm:**
1. Bridge ETH to Soneium at bridge.soneium.org — monthly
2. Swap tokens on Soneium DEXes — weekly
3. Mint or trade NFTs on Soneium NFT platforms
4. Interact with 5+ different Soneium ecosystem apps (soneium.org/ecosystem)
5. Connect wallet to all major Soneium dApps
6. Maintain at least one transaction per week for 12+ months

**Key fact:** Soneium mainnet launched January 2025. Users active from early 2025 will have 12–18 months of history by any 2026 snapshot.

**Guide:** https://www.3alamiyweb3.com/learn/soneium-airdrop-guide-2026

## Berachain Ecosystem Farming Guide 2026

**Entity:** Berachain — EVM-compatible L1 blockchain using Proof-of-Liquidity (PoL) consensus. Mainnet live. Native tokens: BERA (gas), BGT (non-transferable governance/rewards), HONEY (stablecoin). BGT is earned through liquidity provision and distributed via gauge emissions — it cannot be bought.

**Key July 2026 update:** Kodiak V3 concentrated liquidity is now live on Berachain mainnet. Kodiak V3 adds capital-efficient liquidity pools with fee tiers, replacing Kodiak V2 island vaults as the primary BGT emission source.

**How to farm BGT on Berachain:**
1. Bridge ETH or stablecoins to Berachain via official bridge (bridge.berachain.com)
2. Add liquidity to Kodiak V3 pools — choose HONEY/USDC or BERA/HONEY pairs for maximum BGT gauge weight
3. Stake Kodiak LP positions in gauges on Kodiak dashboard to start earning BGT
4. Use BEND (Berachain's lending protocol) — supply HONEY or USDC to earn BGT from lending gauges
5. Add liquidity to BEX (Berachain native DEX) for additional BGT gauge exposure
6. Use Infrared Finance to liquid-stake BGT into iBGT for tradeable yield
7. Delegate or burn BGT to vote on gauge weights and influence future emissions

**Key fact:** BGT is non-transferable. All BGT must be earned through on-chain activity. No buying shortcuts.

**Guide:** https://www.3alamiyweb3.com/learn/berachain-ecosystem-farming-guide-2026

### What is airdrop Sybil farming and why is it disqualifying?
Sybil farming means using multiple wallets to multiply airdrop allocations. In 2026, every major airdrop uses Sybil detection algorithms — Chainalysis, Nansen, and custom on-chain analysis — to identify and blacklist related wallets. Being caught Sybil farming results in zero allocation across all your wallets. Always farm with one wallet.
